name: brand-management-production-upgrade
title: Upgrade restaurant chain management for production
description: Reshape the manager restaurant-chain screen into a production-ready dashboard using the shared sage visual system, clearer Vietnamese wording, resilient mutation feedback, and responsive branch/member management.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Backend Brand and BrandMembership contracts already support the required operations and scope rules. The production upgrade is page-scoped: it adds the shared sage dashboard treatment, explicit states, validation, mutation feedback, branch/member organization, and removes duplicate refetches without changing shared hooks, role helpers, schema, resolvers, or permissions. PR CI must pass before merge; authenticated desktop and mobile visual review remains manual.
